{
  "sections": [
    {
      "title": "Your medicines",
      "bullets": [
        {
          "id": "b1",
          "text": "Furosemide 40 mg, take two times a day by mouth. It is a water pill that helps your body get rid of extra fluid and lowers high blood pressure.",
          "sources": ["p1:L11", "term:BID", "term:PO", "drug:furosemide"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b2",
          "text": "Lisinopril 20 mg, take once a day by mouth. It is a blood pressure medicine that also helps a weak heart and protects the heart after a heart attack.",
          "sources": ["p1:L12", "term:PO", "drug:lisinopril"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b3",
          "text": "Carvedilol 12.5 mg, take two times a day by mouth with food. It is a heart medicine that lowers blood pressure, helps a weak heart work better, and protects the heart after a heart attack.",
          "sources": ["p1:L13", "term:BID", "term:PO", "drug:carvedilol"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b4",
          "text": "Clopidogrel 75 mg, take once a day by mouth. It is a blood thinner that helps prevent heart attacks and strokes.",
          "sources": ["p1:L14", "term:PO", "drug:clopidogrel"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b5",
          "text": "Rosuvastatin 40 mg, take every night at bedtime by mouth. It is a cholesterol-lowering medicine that helps prevent heart attacks and strokes.",
          "sources": ["p1:L15", "term:QHS", "term:PO", "drug:rosuvastatin"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b6",
          "text": "Check the dose of Carvedilol with your care team before taking it. The hospital record says 25 mg but your discharge paper says 12.5 mg.",
          "sources": ["conflict:conflict-2", "p1:L13", "record:32"]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
